entries.reason: the release does not carry it at all: read from 6.1.3's own MediaPlayer with tools/mach32_methods.py, MPMediaItemArtwork's 13 own instance methods do not include initWithBoundsSize:requestHandler: (negative control: a selector no framework has is absent). The release does declare imageWithSize:, so the handler behaviour cannot be a category method - that would be shadowed by the release's own on the release's class.
entries.effect: a caller gets a CharonHandlerMediaItemArtwork, a port subclass: isKindOfClass: is true of MPMediaItemArtwork, imageWithSize: asks the handler for the size the caller wanted and returns its result, and bounds is the size the initialiser was given. Real artwork is an MPConcreteMediaItemArtwork and is untouched.
